-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/snd

go 1.27

require example.com/oth v0.0.0

replace example.com/oth => ../oth

-- dep/snd.go --
package snd

func Spawn(b []byte) { go func() { b[0] = 1 }() }

func Run(b []byte) { func() { b[0] = 1 }() }

func Later(b []byte) { defer func() { b[0] = 1 }() }

type Box struct{ N int }

func (b *Box) Set(v int) { b.N = v }

func (b *Box) Fill(xs []byte, v byte) { xs[0] = v }

func Write(b []byte) int { return len(b) }

type Zed struct{ n int }

func (z *Zed) Write(b []byte) { b[0] = 1; z.n++ }

func Pick(b []byte) (r []byte) { r = b; return }

func Pass(b []byte) ([]byte, int) { x, n := b, 1; return x, n }

func Pick2(b []byte, c bool) []byte {
	x := b
	if c {
		x = nil
	}
	return x
}

type Holder struct{ items [][]byte }

func (h *Holder) Push(b []byte) { h.items = append(h.items, b) }

func Keep(dst [][]byte, b []byte) [][]byte { return append(dst, b) }

func CopyRefs(dst, src [][]byte) { copy(dst, src) }

func Offer(ch chan []byte, b []byte) {
	select {
	case ch <- b:
	default:
	}
}

func Fill2(b []byte) int { b[0] = 1; return 1 }

func Total2(b []byte) int {
	total := 0
	total += Fill2(b)
	return total
}

func Scrub(rows [][]byte) {
	for _, r := range rows {
		r[0] = 0
	}
}

func ScrubMap(rows map[string][]byte) {
	for _, r := range rows {
		r[0] = 0
	}
}

var Held []byte

func LeakPtr(b []byte) { p := &Held; *p = b }

func Mutate(b []byte) int { b[0] = 1; return 1 }

func CondCall(b []byte) bool {
	if n := Mutate(b); n > 0 {
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func PostW(b []byte) {
	for i := 0; i < 1; b[0]++ {
	}
}

func Zero2(bs ...[]byte) {
	for i := range bs {
		bs[i][0] = 0
	}
}

func Wrap2(b []byte) { Zero2(nil, b) }

var pool [][]byte

func regs() [][]byte { return pool }

func Store(xs []byte) { regs()[0] = xs }

-- dep/other.go --
package snd

import "example.com/oth"

func LeakOther(b []byte) { oth.Held2 = b }

-- dep/mid/mid.go --
package mid

import "example.com/snd"

func ViaZed(b []byte) { var z snd.Zed; z.Write(b) }

func Use(b *snd.Box) { b.Set(1) }

-- oth/go.mod --
module example.com/oth

go 1.27

-- oth/oth.go --
package oth

var Held2 []byte

-- imp/go.mod --
module example.com/sndimp

go 1.27

require (
	example.com/snd v0.0.0
	example.com/oth v0.0.0
)

replace example.com/snd => ../dep

replace example.com/oth => ../oth

-- imp/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import "example.com/snd"

type U struct {
	box *snd.Box
}

func (u U) Reset() {
	u.box.Set(1)
}

-- imp/badc1spawn/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/snd"

func main() {
	b := []byte{1}
	var view const []byte = b
	snd.Spawn(view)
}

-- imp/badc1run/main.lgo --

import "example.com/snd"

	snd.Run(view)
}

-- imp/badc2/main.lgo --

import (
	"example.com/snd"
	"example.com/snd/mid"
)

func main() {
	bx := snd.Box{}
	var view const *snd.Box = &bx
	mid.Use(view)
}

-- imp/badc2lo/main.lgo --

import "example.com/sndimp/lib"

func main() {
	cu := lib.U{}
	var view const lib.U = cu
	view.Reset()
}

-- imp/badm1clone/main.lgo --
package main

import "maps"

func main() {
	src := map[string][]byte{"k": {1}}
	var m const map[string][]byte = src
	c := maps.Clone(m)
	c["k"][0] = 1
}

-- imp/badm1all/main.lgo --
package main

import "maps"

func main() {
	src := map[string][]byte{"k": {1}}
	var m const map[string][]byte = src
	for _, v := range maps.All(m) {
		v[0] = 1
	}
}

-- imp/l2eq/main.lgo --
package main

import "bytes"

func main() {
	a := []byte{1, 2, 3}
	var va const []byte = a
	println(bytes.Equal(va, a))
}
